contentBody: **Why aggregate raw data before pasting it into AI?**
option.1: AI can't read tables over 10 rows
option.2: It removes the need to verify later
option.3: Raw rows must become images first
option.4: A small table is easier to check
answerExplanation: Aggregation makes the prompt and the answer easier to verify — it doesn't remove the need to check.

contentBody: **A report says only "average attendance was 85%." What's missing?**
option.2: The trend pattern and any unusual days
answerExplanation: One overall number alone leaves out the macro pattern and any anomalies.

contentBody: **AI says sales "tripled" (3 to 9 items). What should you check first?**
option.1: Nothing, the maths is correct so it's fine
option.3: Whether the sample size is big enough to matter
answerExplanation: The maths is right, but 3 to 9 is too small a sample to call it a real trend.
